show.name: Battle Through the Heavens
show.summary: In a land where no magic is present. A land where the strong make the rules and weak have to obey. A land filled with alluring treasures and beauty, yet also filled with unforeseen danger. Three years ago, Xiao Yan, who had shown talents none had seen in decades, suddenly lost everything. His powers, his reputation, and his promise to his mother. What sorcery has caused him to lose all of his powers? And why has his fiancee suddenly shown up?

show.name: Dive into You
show.summary: Yun Ha Na is a top actress adored across Asia, living a glamorous life at the height of her career. But after a mysterious accident causes her soul to switch with that of her twin brother, Yun Ha Ru, she suddenly finds herself thrown back into the past. Faced with a second chance to change fate, Ha Na becomes determined to save her first love, Jung U Jae — a former judo prodigy turned bodyguard who once lost his life protecting her. As Ha Na struggles to navigate the past in the midst of unexpected chaos, Ha Ru must cope with waking up in his sister's body, leading to a series of unpredictable and emotional moments. Alongside them is Son Ye Rang, Ha Na's powerful agency CEO and Ha Ru's devoted lover, whose strong exterior hides a deeply vulnerable side. Four young people whose intertwined destinies challenge love, sacrifice, and the possibility of rewriting the past.

show.name: Small Town Remedy
show.summary: This series tells the story of Liu Zhengliang (Played by Xiao Zhan), a genius doctor who suffers a major life setback and is forced to return to his hometown to start over. He gathers a group of seemingly "unreliable" people, and they passionately commit to doing the most reliable, meaningful things. Surrounded by the cozy, bustling neighborhood vibe, they weave warm daily moments with human kindness, offering life prescriptions that heal people's souls.

show.name: The Lament of Autumn
show.summary: In the turbulent 1920s, Yu Changxuan and Ye Pingjun fall into a love-hate entanglement, defying war and fate together.

show.name: Where the Mask Ends
show.summary: Chou was once a lowly night-soil collector, bullied and mistreated by everyone around her. But her striking resemblance to Wei Rao, the daughter of a marquis, unexpectedly makes her the bride of Lu Zhuo, the heir to a duke's household, in a marriage arranged to bring him good fortune and save his life. Ambitious and determined to rise above her station, Chou sees the marriage as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, her critically ill husband suddenly awakens, and her assumption of another woman's place brings one disaster after another. Furious that Chou has taken her place, Wei Rao is desperate to get rid of her. Meanwhile, Lu Zhuo regards Chou as a vicious and scheming woman, constantly guarding against her and plotting against her. Beneath the seemingly harmonious facade of the duke's household lie countless traps and deadly schemes. Caught in the midst of these hidden conflicts, Chou struggles to navigate the competing interests around her while carefully planning her future. Determined to break free from the shackles of fate, she eventually uncovers the secrets of her own origins and reunites with her loved ones. Rising from a humble night-soil collector to a woman of status, she transforms her life and creates a brilliant future for herself.

show.name: My Loong
show.summary: Yue Wangshu, the daughter of a military family, is offered as a sacrifice to the Dragon Abyss. There, she accidentally releases the Dragon Lord Li Zhi. From hostility to mutual understanding, they form an alliance based on a bargain to suppress the Li Fire. She uses the Dragon Lord's power to fight back against the plots of the Yue family and Prince Qi, while he learns human love through her. Ultimately, Li Zhi chooses to remain in the human world, and the two create an epic romance.

show.name: Dear Song
show.summary: To seek justice for her father, Yu Song takes a job as an assistant in the Song household. Her sincerity wins Song Cheng over, and she teams up with Jing, a driver, to gather evidence and expose the Song family's crimes. But she refuses to let hatred consume her. She breaks free from what has held her back and realizes that real victory means taking control of her own life. In the end, she embraces life with newfound freedom and hope.

show.name: Slumbering With Wolves
show.summary: Focusing on the growth of young people in the new era and the pursuit of the rule of law and justice, the story follows criminal psychology expert Gu Yan and his partner Shen Yu as they stay true to their original ideals and justice, work together to solve perplexing cases, and uncover the truth. Blending suspenseful mind games with reflections on human nature, it focuses on real-world issues such as moral limits and self-protection. It keeps pace with the times, with a fresh narrative approach and tight pacing.

show.name: Overseas Security Guard
show.summary: Set against the Belt and Road backdrop, this drama focuses on a real-world story of overseas private security. Wei Tian, a man with top-level protective skills, loses his wife and daughter in a terrorist attack. He assumes a hidden identity in Antilocaris and forms a private security squad called "The Silent Ones" to protect Chinese compatriots living abroad.

show.name: Decoding You
show.summary: Krit, the polished CEO of a data analytics empire, has always put family and duty above his own heart. When a scandal linked to his ex-lover tarnishes his reputation, his controlling mother forces him into a fake marriage with Non—his adopted younger brother who has secretly loved him for years. What begins as a staged arrangement soon turns real as Non steps out of Krit's shadow and catches someone else's eye, awakening emotions Krit can no longer deny. But when their relationship sparks a public scandal, Krit must choose between protecting the perfect life he's built or risking everything for a love he never expected.

body.name: River Ribble, Lancashire - Barbel
body.summary:
Paul and Bob travel to the River Ribble in Lancashire for one last fish with their little canine pal, Ted.

The beautiful river Ribble runs through the rolling hills of the Yorkshire Dales, onwards to Lancashire before meeting the Irish Sea in Lytham. With the river in good health, Paul and Bob hope to catch a good chub or a mighty barbel on this stretch of the water, while Ted hopes to taste Bob's Lancashire hotpot.

show.name: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
show.summary: Two friends, beautiful places and a good natter. Bob Mortimer and Paul Whitehouse go on a life-affirming, funny journey, sharing their changed outlooks and trying to land a catch.

body.name: Breckland Lakes, Norfolk - Bream
body.summary:
Paul and Bob are back in Norfolk - a bittersweet return, as this was the very first location where Ted joined them. They both reminisce about Ted and raise a cup in his memory - although Ted would have preferred a biscuit.

They head to some prime Norfolk lakes, hoping to catch a bream. It's been well documented that Bob is not a fan of the bream, but will a big catch make him change his tune?

It's Paul and Bob's birthday week, and they consider whether they may celebrate any further milestones or simply let them pass. Bob ends up throwing a surprise 70s-themed birthday party for Paul on the roof of the Blickling Estate, once owned by the Boleyn family.

show.name: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
show.summary: Two friends, beautiful places and a good natter. Bob Mortimer and Paul Whitehouse go on a life-affirming, funny journey, sharing their changed outlooks and trying to land a catch.

body.name: Shetland - Trout and Pollock
body.summary:
Paul and Bob venture to the northernmost reaches of the UK – Shetland – to fish the lochs and the seas of this remote and beautiful place for trout and pollock.

Shetland is an archipelago of about 100 islands off the north east coast of Scotland, only around 15 of which are inhabited. It feels like they have entered a very different world - and it's full of surprises for both of them.

show.name: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
show.summary: Two friends, beautiful places and a good natter. Bob Mortimer and Paul Whitehouse go on a life-affirming, funny journey, sharing their changed outlooks and trying to land a catch.

body.name: River Tees, County Durham - Trout
body.summary:
Bob and Paul are in County Durham, fishing the River Tees for a rare species of wild brown trout.

They navigate the area through the lens of a six-year-old Bob as he takes Paul on a trip along the landscapes of his youth. Bob lost his dad when he was very young, but one of the memories he holds dear to him are the fishing trips they used to go on.

Later, Bob invites their old friend Reece Shearsmith to dinner, and he has some particularly spooky local tales to tell them about the River Tees.

show.name: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
show.summary: Two friends, beautiful places and a good natter. Bob Mortimer and Paul Whitehouse go on a life-affirming, funny journey, sharing their changed outlooks and trying to land a catch.

body.name: Baronscourt Estate, County Tyrone - Pike
body.summary:
Paul and Bob travel to County Tyrone to fish at Baronscourt Estate, hoping to catch a pike of a lifetime.

They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of one rowing boat – what could possibly go wrong?

Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey. Bob has a fail-safe method to try, but will the duo be able to outwit the elusive creatures?

show.name: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
show.summary: Two friends, beautiful places and a good natter. Bob Mortimer and Paul Whitehouse go on a life-affirming, funny journey, sharing their changed outlooks and trying to land a catch.

body.name: Beaulieu River, Hampshire - Mullet
body.summary:
Paul and Bob are in Beaulieu, Hampshire, to fish both the river and the adjoining Solent. They're here to fish for mullet, and later take a boat trip up the Solent to try for a smooth hound.

The Beaulieu river is one of only a handful of rivers privately owned in the UK. It's been in the Montagu family since the 18th century, and Paul and Bob have been given special permission to fish here.

Later, they are joined by their doctor friend Anand Patel for an evening tipple and an update on their health. Paul is keen to discuss his most recent diagnosis, while Bob asks Anand to examine his feet for a common sign of ageing.

body.summary: Tom's 15-year-old daughter Jess has started a relationship with schoolmate Ollie. When he meets the boy's mum Beth in a chance encounter, a spark is lit between the two married people and both their families' lives are turned upside down.

show.name: Adultery
show.summary:
Adultery introduces us to Tom's 15-year-old daughter Jess who has found love with schoolmate Ollie, and they can't take their hands off one another, as love's young dream becomes all consuming. When Tom meets Ollie's Mum Beth in the most unexpected of circumstances, the two families' lives are potentially turned upside down forever. Will Tom and Beth be able to control their desires unlike their lovestruck teenagers?

Adultery raises questions about class, grief and the effects of social media, as it takes the viewer on a rollercoaster story of passion, parenthood and peril, as our protagonists Tom and Beth embark upon a passionate and intense love affair that threatens to uproot their whole lives.

show.name: Emmerdale
show.summary: Emmerdale is a British soap focusing on the lives of several families and locals living around an estate, a farm and the nearby village in the Yorkshire Dales. It is the second longest British soap in television history since airing its first episode on ITV in 1972, as 'Emmerdale Farm', the show was renamed in 1989.

show.name: Coronation Street
show.summary: Step onto the cobbles for all the drama, secrets and unforgettable moments from the world's longest running TV soap.

show.name: 10 NEWS+
show.summary:
10 NEWS+ will follow Network 10's 5pm local news bulletins across the country, offering viewers extended context and deeper reporting on the day's biggest stories. The 5pm bulletin remains a cornerstone of the network's trusted news offering, delivering the latest breaking news and updates.

10 NEWS+ aims to redefine evening news by providing comprehensive analysis, trusted reporting, and long-form investigative journalism. The program will offer a fresh perspective on critical local and global stories, tailored for an engaged audience seeking in-depth news coverage.

At a time when misinformation is rife, 10 NEWS+ is steadfast in its commitment to truth and transparency, delivering journalism with integrity, clarity, and purpose.

Designed for Australia's evolving media landscape, 10 NEWS+ will integrate across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms, ensuring content is accessible and engaging for Australians everywhere.

The program will be anchored Sunday to Thursday by investigative journalist Denham Hitchcock and Walkley Award-winning journalist Amelia Brace, with Senior Journalist and respected news anchor Ursula Heger and National Affairs Editor Hugh Riminton leading coverage every Friday.

body.name: Objectives
body.summary: "Taiyo and the others learn that the Spy Association HQ has been rigged with bombs. They have less than an hour before they explode! They must stop them, or the ensuing drastic accident will involve legitimate society as well. The intruders have the ability to shape-shift into staff members or spies, and led by Kai, the Gold Rank spies split up to search inside the HQ. Taiyo, along with Ryu and Shinzo, visit the Training Wing, where the children living at the HQ are hard at work. The kids come running when they see Ryu, and soon they're having a lively conversation, but... ?!"

show.name: Mission: Yozakura Family
show.summary: High school student Taiyou Asano has been socially inept ever since his family died in a car crash. The only person he can properly interact with is his childhood friend, Mutsumi Yozakura—the head of the world's strongest family of spies. Mutsumi's eldest brother, Kyouichirou Yozakura, has been overprotective of her ever since he once rendered her severely injured. His love for Mutsumi is lethal, and Taiyou is his next target. To survive, Taiyou must marry Mutsumi and become a member of the Yozakura family. Thrown headfirst into chaos, Taiyou begins his journey to become a powerful spy in order to protect his wife and uncover the dark secrets of his past and the Yozakura family.

show.name: Tigers Sniff the Rose
show.summary: Defying the fate laid out for her, Princess Mu Wanyao joins forces with Yan Shang, a young man of humble origins with an unrivaled gift for strategy, to forge a realm of peace and prosperity. With larger-than-life characters, thrilling twists, and exhilarating triumphs, the story follows a generation of young idealists who rise amid the storms of a troubled age, determined to shape the world around them and pursue their dreams.

show.name: Dushi Gu Xian Yi
show.summary: Ye Bufan, a junior student, tried to scam a car to raise medical expenses for his mother. Unexpectedly, he encountered a female driver who did not play by the rules. After being hit, Ye Bufan accidentally traveled to a fantasy world and obtained the inheritance of ancient medicine. From then on, he mastered medical skills, practiced martial arts, and won the favor of countless beautiful women.

show.name: King of Drag
show.summary: Ten kings. One crown. King of Drag, presented by e.l.f., is the first ever drag KING competition series: where masculinity meets artistry, swagger meets sequins, and drag kings finally take center stage. Hosted by Murray Hill and ruled by the illustrious "Kings' Court" including regular judges Tenderoni, Sasha Velour, Gottmik, and Wang Newton. Each episode features special guest judges, memorable challenges, and a competition like never before.

show.name: The Real Housewives of London
show.summary: The 30th installment of the iconic franchise and the second to be set in England. Join the latest batch of woman living their lives for the camera.

show.name: The Great Long March
show.summary: Revolving around the arduous Long March of the Central Red Army, it documents the historical process—from the army's failure in the fifth counter-encirclement campaign, to the First, Second, Fourth Front Armies of the Red Army and the 25th Red Army launching strategic transfers under the leadership of the CPC Central Committee—to eventual triumph. It extols the unyielding ideals and revolutionary spirit of Mao Zedong and Chinese Communists, and elucidates the history and logic behind the rise and development of the Chinese revolution, proving that adapting Marxism to China's specific conditions was essential for victory.

body.name: South Side Chicago Castles
body.summary: This episode of "Open House Chicago" is one that she wanted to do since the beginning. For part of her childhood, Cortney grew up in the far South Side Chicago neighborhood of Beverly. She remembered it fondly for its tree-lined streets and giant, historic, castle-like homes. We visit two that look like they are ripped straight from the pages of a storybook.

show.name: Open House Chicago
show.summary: An Exclusive, insiders look at the hottest residential properties in the Chicagoland market.

show.name: Fool in Love
show.summary: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

show.name: Sam and Colby
show.summary: Join Sam and Colby as they explore and document the creepiest haunted sites. Maintaining their infectious humor in even the darkest of situations, paranormal investigation has never been more fun.

show.name: Tamed
show.summary: Haunted by childhood trauma, Cheng Yu'an has shut himself off from the world. One rainy night, he takes in Lin Qi and they begin living together under a "master and pet" contract. But the gentle Lin Qi keeps breaking the rules, prompting Cheng Yu an to make exceptions, even going so far as to defy his family for him. As Lin Qi searches for the truth behind his father's death, Cheng Yu'an's buried secrets begin to surface. From offering him shelter to being unable to let him go, who will surrender his heart first in this game of taming? A cold-hearted lawyer and a gentle artist in a steamy romance. From pet to lover, who falls first?

There's only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

show.name: American Hostage
show.summary: The first 8-episode installment of this anthology series is set in the 1970s. The psychological thriller tells the harrowing true story of Fred Heckman, a beloved Indianapolis radio reporter who is thrust into the middle of a life-or-death crisis when hostage-taker Tony Kiritsis demands to be interviewed on his popular radio news program.

body.name: Chapter 3: The Wide Eternal Sea
body.summary: Alliances fracture as the voyage wears on. Bess and Graham play a cat-and-mouse game, while Long John targets Jim; when Graham makes his move, the truth surfaces. The consequences are deadly and Jim is forced to take control of his fate.

show.name: Treasure Island
show.summary: Treasure Island charts the transformation of teenager Jim Hawkins from sheltered boy to emboldened young pirate. When Jim gets his hands on a legendary treasure map, his mother Bess' clever and decisive actions leave him holding valuable knowledge that puts both of their lives in danger.

show.name: Baddies Gone Wild: Cancun
show.summary: The ladies are back and going even wilder! This season, they're taking their energy straight to Cancun for nonstop turn-ups, unforgettable nights, and plenty of unexpected moments along the way. With no telling what can happen when the girls hit the streets, beaches, and nightlife of Mexico, Cancun is about to experience Baddies Gone Wild like never before.

body.name: The Brothers
body.summary: The Alexander brothers ascend to the elite real estate and private security worlds of Miami and New York; behind their luxurious facade, they harbor secrets of their alleged mistreatment of women, which come to light in 2024, unleashing a firestorm.

show.name: The Wolves of Real Estate
show.summary: The Wolves of Real Estate tells the story of three brothers who were recently convicted of preying on women for more than a decade, masquerading as party boys while allegedly drugging and raping women. These claims only came to light when dozens of women came forward, leading to one of the biggest sex trafficking trials of the decade. Delving into the family and brothers' early years, and with access to never-before-seen footage and exclusive interviews, the series exposes a twisted and disturbing tale.

body.name: Back to Miami
body.summary: For some who knew the Alexander brothers growing up, the allegations that arose in 2024 are not a surprise; early stories from their high school years of alleged mistreatment of women surface, unleashing more questions than answers.

show.name: The Wolves of Real Estate
show.summary: The Wolves of Real Estate tells the story of three brothers who were recently convicted of preying on women for more than a decade, masquerading as party boys while allegedly drugging and raping women. These claims only came to light when dozens of women came forward, leading to one of the biggest sex trafficking trials of the decade. Delving into the family and brothers' early years, and with access to never-before-seen footage and exclusive interviews, the series exposes a twisted and disturbing tale.

body.name: The Trial
body.summary: The net closes in on the Alexander brothers, leading to their arrest and one of the biggest sex-trafficking trials of the decade, where more than 11 women testify against them.

show.name: Drag Race España
show.summary: Drag Race España is searching to find Spain's next drag superstar! Each week the queens will be put to the test in numerous contests and challenges. Follow along to see who will survive the fierce competition and claim the crown!

show.name: Dr. Nice
show.summary: Dr. Nice is a heartthrob and star surgeon, until an accident stiffens his right hand. An inheritance leads him to the Flensburg Fjord and to daughter Lea, of whom he knew nothing.

body.name: Week 5
body.summary: Abi and Tyler get all the reaction from the Strictly floor after the dance off.

show.name: Strictly: Lights Up
show.summary: Hosted by comedian Abi Clarke and presenter and Strictly alum Tyler West, Strictly: Lights Up will be available immediately after the results show has finished. Abi and Tyler will take viewers straight on to the Strictly dance floor for immediate reactions from the night's eliminated couple, their dance off opponents - plus the judges, hosts, other Strictly stars and studio guests.

body.name: Episode 7
body.summary: As the experiment enters its final days, East and West relations are at an all-time high. The two groups join together to explore and they stumble upon an uncharted area of the town and make a big find. Chef Dean hosts a banquet. During a game of confessions, one survivor's revelation jeopardises the new-found peace, but both sides will need to work together if they want to finally escape.

show.name: Apocalypse
show.summary:
If the world as we know it came to an end, what would you do? 

Our modern world exists on a knife edge, but if the worst happened, the fight for survival won't be in jungles, forests or desert islands. It'll be in the towns and cities we call home. 

In this bold and ambitious social experiment, Channel 4 is sending a group of ordinary people to a jaw dropping, real world location - an abandoned town that bears all the hallmarks of being ravaged by an apocalyptic event.  They'll have to survive for 28 days without running water, heating, or electricity. They'll need to scavenge for food and supplies, reusing and repurposing anything they find but only if they can muster skills and wherewithal to do it. 

Nothing here comes easy, and in the face of scarce resources will this unlikely group of strangers band together or fall apart?

show.name: Heartland
show.summary: Life is hard on the Flemings' ranch in the Alberta foothills where abused or neglected horses find refuge with a kind, hard-working family. Debts abound and the bank is about to foreclose. Can they keep the ranch running?

body.name: Picnic Week
body.summary: Picnic Week arrives with three bakes that are perfectly portable. The bakers make South African Picnic Bread, Illusion Ants on a Log and Pain Surprise.

show.name: The Great Canadian Baking Show
show.summary: The Great Canadian Baking Show, based on the hit British format, will bring together 10 amateur bakers from across Canada to compete in a series of themed culinary challenges.

body.name: Waiting at the Station
body.summary: As the Hamiltons celebrate Thomas's first birthday, Tina anxiously awaits the arrival of her estranged father, hoping he'll finally meet his grandson. Meanwhile, Janet and Eric take the next step in their relationship.

show.name: Crossroad Springs
show.summary: Crossroad Springs follows the Hamilton family, adult siblings James and Janet, their aging family members, dad, Willis, and Aunt Amy, who are eking out a living on Hamilton Ranch with financial hardships and staffing shortages. James, a pastor in Chicago, and Janet, an ER doctor in a neighboring town, feel called to return home to help the family. Once there, the siblings encounter the son of the owner of the neighboring farm, Daniel Newman, who are all wary of each other due to a generational feud between the families. As he settles into his new day-to-day life on the farm, James begins to realize there are no places to worship on the thousands of acres of farms. There, in the environment of come-as-you-are vibes, barns, rodeo arenas, even outdoors under clear night skies, James starts a cowboy church right there in the place where faith, family, and ranch life go hand in hand.

show.name: Farmen
show.summary: Farmen is a reality TV seriescreated by Swedish producer Strix. Sold to more than 40 countries, The Farm is one of their most popular formats including Survivor, The Bar, or Fame Factory. Like in Big Brother-shows, The Farm puts a group of 12 people living together in a farm. There, the contestants must work as a normal farmer, raising animals and doing agriculture. In regular periods of time, one of the houseguests is evicted, usually in a ceremony called The Duel where they compete in a physical endurance, but in some adaptations of the show its the audience who decide who must leave The Farm.
